let_it_walk.merging_glue.walker: A walker's parts cannot be merged into another body
let_it_walk.assembly.too_few_legs: A walker needs at least one leg hung off the hull with a Leg Hinge or Swivel (found %s)
let_it_walk.controls.active: W/S throttle, A/D turn (V: crab walk), wheel = gear, hold Space to charge a jump (W/A/S/D aim it), Ctrl gallop, X/Z suspension up/down, Alt+mouse lean (Tab: turn), Shift leave
let_it_walk.controls.no_walker: These controls are not on an assembled walker
let_it_walk.controls.no_rotation: The Walker Core needs rotation: connect a turning shaft to its front side
key.let_it_walk.lean: Walker: lean the hull / turn it (hold, move the mouse)
let_it_walk.link.remote_none: Link the remote first: right-click a Walker Core with it
let_it_walk.link.none: Not linked: right-click a Walker Core
let_it_walk.link.controls: Pilot controls linked to this walker
let_it_walk.link.need_link: Right-click a Walker Core to link the pointer first
let_it_walk.link.not_found: The linked walker is not loaded
let_it_walk.positioner.aim: Look at a Leg Hinge or Leg Swivel
let_it_walk.flight.no_jets: Not enough Jet Feet to fly (needs at least half of the legs)
let_it_walk.suction.off: Spikes in: lets go of walls
let_it_walk.gear.needs_rpm: Gear %s needs the shaft at %s RPM or faster
let_it_walk.flight.no_fuel: The jets need lava: pump it into the Walker Core through pipes, or put a Fluid Tank of lava against the core's back
let_it_walk.flight.out_of_fuel: Out of lava: the jets die down
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_core.text_1: The Walker Core is the heart of a walker: place it on the hull you have built
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_core.text_2: Hang legs off the hull with Leg Hinges or Leg Swivels, build them from any blocks and end each in a Leg Foot
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_core.text_3: The core needs rotation on its front face: without it the legs hold the hull up, but it does not walk
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_core.text_4: Right-click the core with an empty hand to assemble the walker
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_core.text_5: Once assembled, right-click it again to park it: the hull settles down and the walker stays put
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_gears.text_1: A walker has five gears, shifted with the mouse wheel - but only as high as its shaft turns fast enough for
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_gears.text_2: At 16 RPM it drives the first two gears
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_gears.text_3: 32 RPM unlocks the third, 64 RPM the fourth
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_gears.text_4: From 128 RPM it can use all five
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_gears.text_5: The stress on the shaft grows with the walker's weight and with what it does: higher gears, flying and holding on to walls cost the most
let_it_walk.ponder.leg_joints.text_1: A leg starts at the hull with a joint; every joint points at the next part of the leg
let_it_walk.ponder.leg_joints.text_2: A Leg Swivel turns everything beyond it about the way it faces: under the hull it swings the leg sideways
let_it_walk.ponder.leg_joints.text_3: A Leg Hinge bends the next part in one plane, as hips and knees do
let_it_walk.ponder.leg_joints.text_4: Between the joints build the leg from any blocks, and end it with a foot
let_it_walk.ponder.leg_joints.text_5: The value panel on a joint's side sets the chain to Arm: an arm keeps its pose and swings along, but does not walk
let_it_walk.ponder.leg_positioner.text_1: Hold the Positioner and look at a Leg Hinge or Leg Swivel: its rest angle shows at the bottom of the screen
let_it_walk.ponder.leg_positioner.text_2: Scroll to turn it 5 degrees a notch, 1 degree with Ctrl held: the leg stands, and walks, from that pose
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_feet.text_1: Every leg ends in a foot: the walker stands and steps on its feet. The Leg Foot grips well and does nothing more
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_feet.text_2: Jet Foot: with them on at least half of its legs, G lifts the walker off and it flies
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_feet.text_3: The jets burn lava: pump it into the Walker Core through pipes (any face but the shaft's), or put a Fluid Tank of it against the core's back. Hovering burns a little, the faster it flies the more
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_feet.text_4: Water puts the jets out at once: the walker drops, and G starts them again only once the Jet Feet are out of it
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_feet.text_5: Spiked Foot: with them on at least half of its legs the walker walks up walls and across ceilings; G pulls the spikes in and lets them out
let_it_walk.ponder.pilot_controls.text_1: Place the Pilot Controls on the walker and right-click them to take the controls
let_it_walk.ponder.pilot_controls.text_2: W/S drive, A/D turn, the mouse wheel shifts gears, Space charges a jump, Ctrl gallops, X/Z raise and lower the hull, Alt and the mouse lean it (Tab: turn it instead), G flies or lets go of walls. Shift leaves
let_it_walk.ponder.pilot_controls.text_3: Shift + right-click opens their menu: right click, left click, Q and E can power Redstone Link frequencies while piloting
let_it_walk.ponder.pilot_controls.text_4: Hold 1 to 4 to move a limb by hand: the arms first, if the walker has any, then the legs from the front. It lifts; the mouse raises and lowers it and swings it forward and back
let_it_walk.flight.flooded: Water in the jets: get the Jet Feet out of the water to start them
let_it_walk.flight.flooded_out: Water got into the jets: they went out. G starts them again, out of the water
let_it_walk.ponder.walker_feet.text_6: Spikes and jets put extra stress on the core's shaft, and both let go when the rotation stops
block.let_it_walk.walker_core.tooltip.su: The _heart of a walker_. Build a hull around it, hang legs off it on _Leg Hinges_ and _Leg Swivels_, and it walks.
block.let_it_walk.walker_core.tooltip.be: Walks while its _front face_ gets _rotation_. A faster shaft unlocks higher _gears_: 16, 32, 64 and 128 RPM for gears 2 to 5.
Grows with the walker's _weight_ and with what it does: high gears, _flying_ and _spikes_ on walls cost the most.
_Jet Feet_ burn lava: pump it in through _pipes_ on any face but the shaft's, or put a _Fluid Tank_ against its back.
block.let_it_walk.walker_core.tooltip.ac: _Assembles_ the walker. Once assembled, _parks_ it or sets it off again.
_Links_ them to this walker: they steer it from anywhere.
block.let_it_walk.leg_hinge.tooltip.summ: A powered joint that _bends_ the next part of a leg _in one plane_, as a hip or a knee does.
block.let_it_walk.leg_hinge.tooltip.beha: Faces away from the block it is placed on, towards the _next segment_. Everything built beyond it moves with the joint.
Set on the value panel at its side: an _Arm_ keeps its pose and swings along instead of walking.
block.let_it_walk.leg_hinge.tooltip.acti: Sets the _angle the leg stands at_.
block.let_it_walk.leg_swivel.tooltip.sum: A powered joint that _turns_ everything beyond it _about the way it faces_. Pointing down under the hull it is a hip that swings the leg sideways.
block.let_it_walk.leg_swivel.tooltip.beh: Faces away from the block it is placed on, towards the _next segment_. Everything built beyond it moves with the joint.
Set on the value panel at its side: an _Arm_ keeps its pose and swings along instead of walking.
block.let_it_walk.leg_swivel.tooltip.act: Sets the _angle the leg stands at_.
block.let_it_walk.leg_foot.tooltip.summa: Ends a _leg_: the walker stands and steps on its feet. A chain of joints with no foot is an _arm_.
block.let_it_walk.leg_foot.tooltip.behav: Grips well and its sole _lies flat_ on the slope under it.
block.let_it_walk.jet_foot.tooltip.summa: A foot with a _jet_ in it. It walks like any other foot.
block.let_it_walk.jet_foot.tooltip.condi: On half the legs or more
block.let_it_walk.jet_foot.tooltip.behav: _G_ lifts the walker off and it _flies_ - the faster it goes, the harder it leans. A charged _jump_ fires the jets and goes three times as high.
Burns _lava_ from the Walker Core or a tank at its back: a little to hover, more the faster it flies.
The jets _go out at once_. G starts them again once the feet are out of it.
A foot with four _spikes_: they dig into what it stands on, and hold it on walls and ceilings.
On half the legs or more
The walker _walks up walls_ it runs into, and along _ceilings_, as on level ground. _G_ pulls the spikes in and lets them out again.
Holding on with the spikes puts extra _stress_ on the core, and they let go a second after the rotation stops.
block.let_it_walk.pilot_controls.tooltip: Steers a walker from its deck - or, once _linked_, from anywhere.

Take the controls: _W/S_ drive, _A/D_ turn, the _wheel_ shifts gears, _Space_ jumps, _Ctrl_ gallops, _X/Z_ raise and lower the hull, _Alt_ and the mouse lean it (_Tab_: turn it instead), _V_ crab walks, _G_ flies or pulls the spikes in and out. _Shift_ leaves.
Opens the menu: _right click_, _left click_, _Q_ and _E_ can power _Redstone Link_ frequencies while piloting.
R-Click a Walker Core with it
_Links_ the controls to that walker: placed anywhere, they steer it from afar.
item.let_it_walk.remote_pilot_controller: Gives _manual control_ of a walker from _anywhere_ in the world.
Sets how a leg _stands_: the rest angle of each joint.
Shows its angle at the bottom of the screen.
Turns it _5 degrees_ a notch, _1 degree_ with _Ctrl_. The leg stands, and walks, from that pose.
advancement.let_it_walk.root.desc: Get a Walker Core: machines that walk
advancement.let_it_walk.first_step.desc: Assemble a walker and walk it from its Pilot Controls
advancement.let_it_walk.liftoff.desc: Fly a walker on its Jet Feet
advancement.let_it_walk.up_the_wall.desc: Walk a walker up a wall on its Spiked Feet
advancement.let_it_walk.colossus.desc: Assemble a walker of 1000 blocks or more
block.let_it_walk.walker_core.tooltip.be: Water deeper than it stands tall: it _swims_, riding at the surface while its legs row; once the feet find the bottom it walks out.
let_it_walk.flight.disabled: Flight is switched off on this server
let_it_walk.config.remember_walk_keys.to: Remembers the walk key held when leaving the pilot controls.
let_it_walk.joint.locked: Joint locked: fixed to the %s side
let_it_walk.ponder.leg_joints.text_6: Shift + right-click a joint with an empty hand to lock it to the part it hangs from: blocks built next to it later will not join it or take it over
let_it_walk.controls.limb: Limb %s held: mouse up/down lifts and lowers its foot, left/right swings it back and forward
let_it_walk.ponder.pilot_controls.text_5: Right-click a Walker Core with the controls in hand to link them: placed anywhere, they steer that walker from afar
block.let_it_walk.jet_mount.tooltip.summ: A plate on the side of any block for a _jet engine_ or a _Spiked Foot_. Up to _three_ side by side join into one platform, one on each.
block.let_it_walk.jet_mount.tooltip.cond: Right-click with a Jet Foot or a Spiked Foot
block.let_it_walk.jet_mount.tooltip.beha: Puts it on the plate. _Shift + right-click_ with an empty hand takes it off.
Shows where the engine or the foot _points_. Hold _right-click_ and move the mouse to turn it, _15 degrees_ a step.
Every engine on the walker fires a _burst_: a dash or a dodge the way they push. Burns a little _lava_.
let_it_walk.jet_mount.aim: Turned %s°, tilted %s° | hold right-click and move the mouse (15° a step)
block.let_it_walk.jet_mount.tooltip.beha: Every Spiked Foot on a mount _takes hold_ of the block or sub-level in front of its claws, as a Sticker does; R again lets go.
key.let_it_walk.grab: Walker: Spiked Feet on Mounts take hold / let go
let_it_walk.grab.nothing: Nothing in front of the Spiked Feet to hold on to
key.let_it_walk.crab: Walker: crab walk on/off (A/D walk sideways)
block.let_it_walk.leg_hinge.tooltip.acti: Switches its _swing_ off (it holds its pose walking) and on again.
block.let_it_walk.leg_swivel.tooltip.act: Switches its _swing_ off (it holds its pose walking) and on again.
key.let_it_walk.lean_mode: Walker: Alt + mouse leans or turns (switch)
let_it_walk.assembly.split: Walker assembled from one body: %s legs split off
